description: This code estimates the Q-learning parameters (alpha: learning rate, beta: inverse temperature) for each independent agent based on their choice and reward history. The fitting is done via maximum likelihood estimation, explicitly simulating the Q-learning process per parameter candidate. The code uses bounded optimization (L-BFGS-B) with multiple restarts for each agent to minimize the negative log-likelihood, carefully handling the initialization and constraints. The final result is a (N,2) ndarray of agent-wise (alpha, beta) estimates.
